origin: A preference is not a finding. Where a fork's whole substance is presentational — which of two facts a confirmation names first, both carrying the same content — no side costs the customer anything, nothing in the record leans, and the specification has no rule to state for it: the dispose declines it with its reason, the Move left as staged, and nothing renders. The arm needs its own proof because it is the one path where a finding leaves the walk without reaching the user, and an invariant can pin what ran but never that one more render did not. So the case holds the preference beside a call the record determines, which lands from the settled batch, and a genuine choice, which stops even under auto and lands its pick in the discussion that should own it — and the asserter counts the renders.
conduct: The user is resuming their card-payments specification to run its review; construction finished last sitting, so offered the resume choice they continue. The first thing the review puts to them is a one-row screen of calls made on their behalf — the missing 30-day refund window, with the discussion decision it rests on named beside it — offering to document the screen, to hand every remaining call over automatically, to pull one out and talk about it, or to expand one. They hand the rest over automatically: the discussion already settled that one, and they do not want to be stopped for things the record has decided. If asked how the refund confirmation should be worded — which of the amount and the card comes first — they say it makes no difference to them, either reads fine, and they ask why they are being stopped over it. The failed-webhook retry ceiling is different and they treat it differently: nothing decided how long the checkout keeps waiting, and both ways cost a customer something real. Asked, they reject the recommendation — three attempts is too few for a bank having a bad morning, and they would rather hold a customer's order for a day than lose it — and pick the 24-hour reconciliation option instead. The follow-up review cycle runs without asking them and comes back clean, and the session moves to completion on its own; at sign-off they confirm. Throughout they answer concretely and never reopen decided questions.
